create_patterns.name: selection-missed-heat-when-microwave-or-heat-verb-mentioned.md
create_patterns.content: Tasks t2 (Heat a tomato and place it on the table) and t6 (Heat up a black mug in the microwave, put in cabinet). Ground truth pick_heat_then_place. Nothing was loaded. The verb 'heat' plainly matches the skill. Select pick_heat_then_place when the task heats something, even if it also names a destination such as a cabinet or table.

create_patterns.name: selection-missed-cool-when-cooled-adjective-used.md
create_patterns.content: Task t3: 'Place a cooled plate in the cupboard beneath the sink'. Ground truth pick_cool_then_place. Nothing was loaded. The cue is the adjective 'cooled', and the task never says 'cool the plate'. The sink in the destination is a distractor and does not mean clean. Select the cool skill.

create_patterns.name: selection-missed-clean-when-sink-water-implied.md
create_patterns.content: Task t7: 'Put soap in the sink with water to be placed on the toilet lid'. Ground truth pick_clean_then_place. Nothing was loaded. The task never says 'clean' or 'wash'. The cue is sink and water, which imply washing. Treat sink-with-water phrasing as a clean-then-place cue.

create_patterns.name: selection-missed-two-object-when-two-counted.md
create_patterns.content: Tasks t5 ('two spray bottles') and t8 ('two sets of keys'). Ground truth pick_two_obj_and_place. Nothing was loaded. The word 'two' is an explicit count cue. Select the two-object skill instead of single pick_and_place.

create_patterns.name: selection-missed-plain-place-for-simple-put.md
create_patterns.content: Tasks t1 and t4: 'Put a salt shaker in the drawer' and 'Put a salt shaker on the black table'. Ground truth pick_and_place. Nothing was loaded. When there is one object, no transform and no count, load pick_and_place. Not loading anything is the failure here.
